title: Holdback for Devices Without an Erasure Certificate on a Northbeam Renew Trade-In Batch
content:
A batch is closed out before every serial on it carries its erasure certificate, and the holdback the serials without one attract stands against the credit until they do. The holdback the devices without an erasure certificate attract follows the erasure certificates recorded on the agreement against the devices booked in: the devices without a certificate are the devices booked in less the erasure certificates standing recorded on the Northbeam Renew Trade-In agreement, never fewer than none.

| How the data on the batch stands, and the certificates against the devices booked in | The holdback |
| --- | --- |
| the data stands pending, and fewer erasure certificates stand recorded on the agreement than the devices booked in | the uncertified device holdback of 25.00 USD for each device booked in without a certificate |
| the data stands verified by the retailer, and fewer erasure certificates stand recorded on the agreement than the devices booked in | the certified device holdback of 8.00 USD for each device booked in without a certificate |
| an erasure certificate stands recorded for every device booked in | nothing |

**Reading the branches.** Each of the first two is a pair: the state the data on the batch stands in, and fewer certificates on record than devices booked in. Where a certificate stands for every device booked in, nothing is held back whatever state the data stands in; and where the data stands in some other state than pending or verified by the retailer, nothing is held back on this account.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A batch of 31 devices booked in with 22 erasure certificates on record has 9 devices without a certificate. With the data standing pending the holdback is 25.00 USD for each of the 9, or 225.00 USD. With the data standing verified by the retailer the holdback is 8.00 USD for each of the 9, or 72.00 USD. With 31 certificates on record nothing is held back.
